newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit rebounds on squaring of short positions.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit rebounds on squaring of short positions.

text.p: The ringgit recovered to end the day higher in Asia as players covered their short positions ahead of the Thursday holiday in Malaysia, dealers said on Wednesday.
"Market is just squaring off. Somehow many seemed to have been caught long along the way," said the head of dealing at a foreign Bank in Kuala Lumpur.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5080/90 a dollar after touching a high of 2.5070. It opened at 2.5107/17.
Dealers said activity was expected thin in London and New York due to the May Day holiday.
Dealers said there was also mild ringgit/Singapore dollar buying for most of the day.
They said the fresh ringgit covering overwhelmed dollar buying for month-end corporate demand.
